parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate moments using a balancing method. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 1.1. Fig. 1.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Place the metre rule on the pivot, without the loads P and Q, and adjust its position so that the metre rule is as near as possible to being balanced. The rule must remain at this position on the pivot throughout the experiment . Place the load P on the metre rule so that the edge that is furthest from the pivot is exactly at the 10.0 cm mark on the rule. Record in Table 1.1, the distance a between this edge of the load P and the pivot, as shown in Fig. 1.1. Place the load Q on the metre rule and adjust the position of load Q so that the metre rule is as near as possible to being balanced. Determine the distance b between the centre of load Q and the pivot, as shown in Fig. 1.1. Record the distance b in Table 1.1. Repeat the procedure, with the edge of the load P that is furthest from the pivot at the 15.0 cm, 20.0 cm, 25.0 cm and 30.0 cm marks. Record all the readings in Table 1.1. Table 1.1 a / cm b / cm [2]

ms.label: 1(a)
ms.text:
a values decreasing
b values decreasing, all values in cm

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Plot a graph of a / cm ( y -axis) against b / cm ( x -axis). Start both axes at the origin (0,0). [4]
